tool_arguments.query: Broadcom AI semiconductor revenue Q3 fiscal 2026 custom AI accelerators XPUs

events.content: Broadcom AI semiconductor revenue Q3 fiscal 2026 custom AI accelerators XPUs

Broadcom reported **$16.7 billion of AI-semiconductor revenue in fiscal Q3 2026**, ended **August 2, 2026**, up **221% year over year** and **54% sequentially**. [[1]] 

Management attributed the acceleration to very strong demand for **custom AI accelerators (XPUs)** and AI networking; total company revenue was **$29.6 billion**, so AI semiconductors represented roughly **56%** of quarterly revenue. [[1]] [[2]] 

The XPU product cycle included high-volume delivery of Google’s **Ironwood TPU v7** to Google and Anthropic, while Broadcom also identified custom XPU programs for OpenAI (“Jalapeño”) and Meta (MTIA). [[3]] 

For fiscal Q4 2026, Broadcom guided AI-semiconductor revenue to **$21.7 billion**, or **236% year-over-year growth**, implying continued sharp expansion in custom accelerators and networking. [[1]]

Sources:
[S1.1] Broadcom Inc. Announces Third Quarter Fiscal Year 2026 Financial Results and Quarterly Dividend — https://investors.broadcom.com/news-releases/news-release-details/broadcom-inc-announces-third-quarter-fiscal-year-2026-financial

tool_arguments.query: Broadcom custom AI accelerator XPU revenue breakdown fiscal Q3 2026

events.content: Broadcom custom AI accelerator XPU revenue breakdown fiscal Q3 2026

Broadcom’s fiscal Q3 2026—ended August 2, 2026—AI semiconductor revenue was **$16.7 billion**, up **221% year over year** and **54% sequentially**. [[1]]

| Q3 FY2026 AI-semiconductor revenue breakdown | Share of AI revenue | Revenue |
|---|---:|---:|
| Custom AI accelerators / XPUs | 73% | **~$12.2bn** |
| AI networking—including Ethernet switching and optical interconnects | 27% | **~$4.5bn** |
| **Total AI semiconductor revenue** | **100%** | **$16.7bn** |

Broadcom said XPU shipment volume increased by **more than 3.5x year over year** and constituted **73%** of AI revenue; AI-networking revenue increased by **more than 2.5x year over year**. [[2]] 

On this basis, XPU revenue represented roughly **41.2%** of Broadcom’s total Q3 consolidated revenue of **$29.6 billion**. [[1]] [[2]]

Sources:
[S3.1] Broadcom Inc. Announces Third Quarter Fiscal Year 2026 Financial Results and Quarterly Dividend — https://investors.broadcom.com/news-releases/news-release-details/broadcom-inc-announces-third-quarter-fiscal-year-2026-financial
[S3.2] Broadcom (AVGO) Q3 2026 Earnings Call Transcript — https://www.fool.com/earnings/call-transcripts/2026/09/09/broadcom-avgo-q3-2026-earnings-call-transcript/

tool_arguments.query: Broadcom fiscal year end November 2025 2026 annual report AI semiconductor revenue

events.content: Broadcom fiscal year end November 2025 2026 annual report AI semiconductor revenue

Broadcom’s fiscal 2025 ended **November 2, 2025**—not at the end of November—because its fiscal year ends on the Sunday closest to October 31. [[1]] 

For FY2025, Broadcom reported **$20.0 billion of AI semiconductor revenue**, up **65% year over year**, according to CEO Hock Tan’s year-end earnings-call remarks. [[2]] 

That AI revenue was generated principally from **custom AI accelerators (XPUs) and AI networking**, while Broadcom’s reported Semiconductor Solutions segment revenue was **$36.858 billion**, up 22% year over year. [[1]] [[3]] 

Thus, AI semiconductor revenue represented approximately **54.3%** of FY2025 Semiconductor Solutions revenue ($20.0bn ÷ $36.858bn). [[2]] [[1]] 

For context, Broadcom reported total FY2025 revenue of **$63.887 billion**, including **$36.858 billion** in Semiconductor Solutions and **$27.029 billion** in Infrastructure Software. [[1]] 

There is **no FY2026 annual report yet** as of October 17, 2026: Broadcom had reported through fiscal Q3 ended August 2, 2026, and guided Q4 to end November 1, 2026. [[4]] 

Based on reported FY2026 quarterly AI semiconductor revenue of **$8.4 billion in Q1**, **$10.8 billion in Q2**, and **$16.7 billion in Q3**, plus the company’s **$21.7 billion Q4 forecast**, FY2026 AI semiconductor revenue would total approximately **$57.6 billion if Q4 guidance is achieved**; this is an estimate, not an annual-report result. [[5]] [[6]] [[4]]
